Get ACB Team Records

Source: R/acb.R
acb_team_records.Rd

A club's single-game records (best performance per statistic).

One row per statistic (stat): value is the record, with the game (game_id, game_date), the player and both teams of that game. Records go back to 1983-84; game_id is a match id of the legacy sequence.

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/seasondata/TeamProfile/team-records

Usage

acb_team_records(club_id)

Arguments

club_id

(required) ACB club id (integer), stable across seasons and sponsor names (2 = Barca, 9 = Real Madrid, 13 = Valencia Basket). Not the season-team team_id. A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per record described above; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py acb_team_records):

col_nametypedescription
club_idintegerStable club id asked for.
statcharacterRecord category in snake_case (rating, points, rebounds, assists, steals, ...).
valuenumericThe record value (a count; Float64 so every category fits).
game_idintegerMatch id of the record game (legacy sequence for old games).
game_datePOSIXctDate of the record game (UTC midnight).
player_idintegerACB licence number: the person id everywhere. A player's box-score player.id, his play-by-play and shot playerLicenseId and the playerLicenceId / playerLicense request params hold the same number (all 24 players of match 105401 match). 20209407 = Edy Tavares. Older licences start 2020..., recent ones 3000....
player_namecharacterDisplay (sporting) name ('Edy Tavares')
first_namecharacterLegal first name(s)
last_namecharacterLegal last name(s)
shirt_numbercharacterShirt number, a string (” or null when unknown)
game_rolecharacterPosition or staff role, in Spanish: Base (point guard), Escolta (shooting guard), Alero (small forward), Ala-pivot (power forward), Pivot (centre); Entrenador (head coach), Segundo Entrenador / Entrenador Ayudante (assistant coach). Null or ” in many rows
local_team_idintegerHome season-team entry of the record game.
local_club_idintegerHome stable club id of the record game.
local_teamcharacterHome team name in the record game.
local_team_abbrcharacterHome team abbreviation in the record game.
visitor_team_idintegerAway season-team entry of the record game.
visitor_club_idintegerAway stable club id of the record game.
visitor_teamcharacterAway team name in the record game.
visitor_team_abbrcharacterAway team abbreviation in the record game.

Details

  • Legal notice (sdv-internal-refs/acb/README.md, aviso legal of acb.com read 2026-10-12): ACEB, S.A.U. claims intellectual property in the site's databases (the EU sui generis database right) among its other content. It authorises viewing and private copies for personal or journalistic use with the source credited, and requires prior express consent for distribution, reproduction or public communication. These wrappers fetch on the user's behalf; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's decision first. robots.txt allows the paths.

  • Unofficial and unsupported: api2.acb.com is the .NET API behind acb.com and live.acb.com, not a documented public API. It needs the header X-APIKEY, a public key shipped in acb.com's bundle: the runtime sends the documented value ($ACB_API_KEY overrides it), re-reads the live bundle once on a 401, and never prints the key.

  • Seasons: the API keys a season by editionId = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27, 48 = 1983-84, the first). The wrappers take season, the END year (2027 = 2026-27), and the runtime sends editionId = season - 1936. A route that omits season serves the current edition. team_id is a season-team entry (new every season); club_id is the stable club.

  • Coverage: box scores from 1983-84 (old seasons carry only the whole-game period, quarter 0); play-by-play and shots from 2016-17 (earlier games answer empty lists, which raise hoopR_no_data). Shot coordinates come in two systems, split by match id: millimetres from the attacked basket from 2020-21 (coord_system mm), a 0-100 full-court percent grid before (grid). A game that is not finished (matchFinished false) raises hoopR_asset_fetch for the routes that report it.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404 / 204, a route whose rows are empty: an unknown id, a game outside a playoff series, play-by-play or shots before 2016-17, a club with no games that season), hoopR_bad_request (a missing, unknown or non-integer argument or a season before 1984, raised before any request; HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a key the API still rejects after one re-read of the bundle, any other non-200 after three attempts, a non-JSON or problem+json body, an error envelope or empty stub, a body for another season, round, club, player or match, a game that is not finished). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
